mechanism: oslo.middleware 8.0.0 changes the CORS allowed_origin configuration value consumed by Nova from a scalar string to a list, breaking the existing functional injection fixture
repair_template: return the dependency's new list-shaped allowed_origin value from the existing target fixture

semantic_review.a1_failure: With oslo.middleware 8.0.0, 12 of the pre-existing 21 Nova CORS functional tests fail because the scalar allowed_origin fixture is no longer consumed as a valid origin list, so the expected CORS response headers are absent.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Opening-cutoff replay independently installed oslo.middleware 7.0.0/8.0.0/8.0.0 for A0/A1/A2 and ran the identical 21-test Nova functional module in all arms. A0 and A2 pass; A1 has 12 mechanism-consistent missing-CORS-header failures. The maintainer patch changes one existing fixture value from string to list and does not delete or skip tests.
semantic_review.source_effect: The opening source diff changes the sole oslo.middleware pin from 7.0.0 to 8.0.0.
semantic_review.target_repair: The maintainer changes the existing allowed_origin fixture from a scalar string to a one-element list; with oslo.middleware 8.0.0 the same 21-test functional module returns to passing.
